cases.name: trim
cases.description: A 4x1x1 bar with a 1x1x1 riser on top of its +X end, sharing the bar's top face. The Propper++ acceptance case: a trim brush selection that must become one prop.
cases.notes: Volume is exact: the two boxes share exactly one face (bar top z=0.5 over x 1..2), so no volume is double-counted. Centre z is 0.5 because the selection spans z -0.5..1.5.
